text: Every day, people put money into DeFi... and then spend hours watching it. Checking risk. Signing transactions. Hoping nothing breaks while they sleep.
And handing your keys to an AI agent? Well, that's a whole different kind of risk.
Meet KRIYA. An autonomous capital protocol, live on Monad. Stop programming transactions. Start programming financial objectives.
You set the goal, say, maximise risk-adjusted yield, and the limits that matter to you. Maximum risk. Maximum exposure. A minimum reserve. That mandate lives inside a smart contract.

Then KRIYA takes over. Chainlink CRE watches real-world risk, and verifies it onchain. Claude decides the best allocation. A policy engine double-checks it. And CRE executes it, end to end. Nobody has to click a button.
So when one strategy's risk jumped from thirty-four to forty-eight, KRIYA verified it, and moved the money out, in just five seconds, on Monad.
And if the AI ever gets it wrong? The contract simply says no. An unsafe allocation just reverts. AI proposes. Contracts enforce.
Monad's fast, low-cost blocks are what make this practical. Every rule, checked onchain, every single time.
KRIYA. Your capital, on autopilot, within your rules. Live now, on Monad testnet.
